# Martin Varley

> Martin Varley is a British entrepreneur and technology strategist. He is Chief Strategy Officer at Altitude Group Plc (AIM: ALT), the UK-listed parent company of AIM Smarter LLC, the largest distributor aggregator in the global promotional products industry, with over 2,300 members and more than $2.3 billion in annual transaction volume. He is co-founder of Merchr and Allergy Alert. Based in London and Miami.

## About

Martin Varley has a track record of building, disrupting and scaling businesses across promotional products, consumer safety and on-demand manufacturing. He applies AI, fintech and data intelligence to industries that have historically been resistant to technological change.

His current focus is leading the AI transformation of AIM Smarter: building agentic commerce infrastructure that combines AI-native tooling, a fintech layer and data intelligence to change how promotional products are bought, sold and financed at scale.

## Roles and ventures

- Altitude Group Plc (AIM: ALT): Chief Strategy Officer, 2021 to present
- Merchr: co-founder; an AI-powered on-demand product platform that lets brands, creators and enterprises merchandise without inventory risk
- Allergy Alert: co-founder; a technology platform addressing allergen management in food service and hospitality
- Altitude Group Plc: founder and Chief Executive, 2005 to 2017
- 4imprint Group plc: European Managing Director; built the European market leader in promotional products, with revenues over $100 million and offices in London, Manchester, Hagen, Paris and Hong Kong
- Brand Addition (originally Broadway Incentives): founder

## Areas of expertise

Artificial intelligence, fintech, agentic commerce, SaaS, the promotional products industry, allergy safety technology, on-demand manufacturing, strategic leadership and business transformation.
